prompt_text: I am planning a trip. Should I book on Airbnb, Vrbo, or Booking.com, and how do I find a good host?
ai_overview_text:
Airbnb: Best for unique stays, apartments, rooms, and urban exploration. It has the largest global inventory, features the "Guest Favorite" badge for top-rated listings (4.9+ stars), and offers strong app usability. Guest service fees typically range from 5% to 15%. AirDNA +5
Vrbo: Best for entire-home vacation rentals, families, and groups (3+ bedrooms) looking for longer stays in coastal or leisure markets. Vrbo defaults to showing total upfront pricing and features a "Premier Host" tier for trusted operators. Total fees generally run around 20% combined. Hospitable Community +4
Booking.com: Best for hotels, urban studios, and short-notice or international travel (especially in Europe and Asia). It handles traditional hotel-style stays well, though short-term rental support and host communication can sometimes feel more transactional. Facebook·Airbnb - Booking - VRBO - Bookavu | Professional Hosts +4
Check the Rating and Review Volume: Look for hosts with a high overall rating (ideally 4.8 or higher) and a substantial number of reviews rather than just two or three glowing comments. Rentals United
Look for Status Badges: On Airbnb, look for the Guest Favorite badge; on Vrbo, look for Premier Host status. These require strict thresholds for low cancellation rates and high cleanliness scores. BNB Mastery·James Svetec +1
Read Recent Reviews Carefully: Scan past guest reviews specifically for mentions of responsiveness, accuracy of the listing, and how the host handles maintenance issues or check-in snags.
Test Communication Before Booking: Send a quick, polite question to the host before booking (e.g., about parking or check-in flexibility). A great host replies promptly, clearly, and helpfully.
Watch Out for Professional vs. Individual Hosts: Check if you are renting from an individual homeowner or a property management company. Property managers offer 24/7 coverage but can feel impersonal, whereas individual hosts offer a more localized touch. BNB Mastery·James Svetec +1
Cross-Check Prices: Use tools like HiChee to see if the same property is listed across multiple platforms (like Airbnb and Vrbo) so you can pick the one with lower total fees. HiChee +2
If you share where you are traveling, how many people are in your group, and your budget, I can help you pick the best platform and neighborhood for your trip.
